notes.title: 1.0.4 - Fixed fatal error which occurred in some circumstances
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would crash if a player was wearing armor which forces them to keep a status effect (e.g. Helium) and wished for "Vitality" on a wishing statue.
[*] Increased the chance of running away from enemies with the fear card from 66% to 75%.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed an issue where the game would crash if a player was wearing armor which forces them to keep a status effect (e.g. Helium) and wished for "Vitality" on a wishing statue.
